body:
Ecstasy and Weed
Sorry if the English isn't correct. It was a long time since I spoke it.
I called a friend and asked him if he wanted to eat MDMA pills. We met and went to another friend, because his parents weren't home. We swallowed the first pill (a long time since I ate one) and waited for about 45 minutes, and then real calm the rush came. In the meantime we listened to some psychedelic trance like astral projection to get in the mood.
Later when I felt the rush come up, I went outside and looked at the sky, it was a beautiful night. As the clouds past by, suddenly there were no clouds and I watched the moon and the pill kicked in. At that moment I rushed and all around me there was light and I felt that the moon was looking at me. I started to dance on music that I heard in my mind, but wasn't there for real. I had this several times, also in other trips. I was waving with my hands like I had enormous powers to move the clouds and still see the moon. When I watched the moon it liked if it was in black ball with water in it, and the moon was floating in it.
And later when a cloud came before the moon my best moment on MDMA ended and I went back inside to my friends. We talked and laughed about a lot of things, and I felt that the friend that hadn't took MDMA, felt also something like a rush or so. That was so cool, like our energy flows around us and go to other people who are in the same room.
